name: Run single 6.6.98 build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'build pipeline version (e.g. android15-6.6)'
        required: true
        default: 'android15-6.6'
      android_version:
        description: 'android branch (e.g. android15)'
        required: true
        default: 'android15'
      kernel_version:
        description: 'kernel major.minor (set to 6.6)'
        required: true
        default: '6.6'
      sublevel:
        description: 'kernel sublevel (set to 98)'
        required: true
        default: '98'
      os_patch_level:
        description: 'OS patch level (e.g. 2026-08 or lts-XX)'
        required: true
        default: '2026-08'
      feature_set:
        description: 'Feature set'
        required: true
        default: 'All'
      variant:
        description: 'Variant'
        required: false
        default: 'Normal'

jobs:
  build-6.6.98:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/build.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
      android_version: ${{ github.event.inputs.android_version }}
      kernel_version: ${{ github.event.inputs.kernel_version }}
      sublevel: ${{ github.event.inputs.sublevel }}
      os_patch_level: ${{ github.event.inputs.os_patch_level }}
      feature_set: ${{ github.event.inputs.feature_set }}
      variant: ${{ github.event.inputs.variant }}
